doubts.claim_under_doubt: validate_release_notes.py's fixed heading vocabulary gate makes it impossible for CHANGELOG text to reach the public release page under an unauthorized heading.
doubts.disproof_attempt: _check_headings scanned only with _HEADING_RE, an exact '^##\s+...$' match. Any other legal ATX heading form (a single '#', '###'+, or a 1-3-space-indented '## ') is still a real, GitHub-rendered heading per CommonMark/GFM but was invisible to the scan. Confirmed live by hand-tracing: a body containing '  ## Not In Vocab' and '### Also Sneaky' headings validated ok=True and both unauthorized headings plus attacker-controlled text appeared unchanged in sanitized_body — a live bypass, not a hypothetical one.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Scan with a heading-level-aware regex covering every legal ATX form (1-3 leading spaces, 1-6 hashes) and reject any heading whose hash count isn't exactly 2, before checking H2 heading text against the allowed vocabulary.
doubts.fix: Added _ANY_ATX_HEADING_RE and rewrote _check_headings to scan with it, rejecting any heading whose hash-count != 2 with a clear reason, then validating H2 text against ALLOWED_HEADINGS as before. Regression tests: test_rejects_a_non_h2_atx_heading (# / ### / ####), test_rejects_an_indented_h2_heading_outside_the_vocabulary, test_allows_an_indented_h2_heading_inside_the_vocabulary.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: A future rename or move of release-notes-prompt.md would be caught by the test suite before it silently degrades condensation.
doubts.disproof_attempt: _PROMPT_PATH is hardcoded in publish_release_notes.py and every existing test that touches it mocks Path.is_file/read_text, so no test ever exercises the real filesystem path — a rename would make every real run report condensation_failed:prompt file missing forever, with all tests still green.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Add one real (non-mocked) test asserting _PROMPT_PATH.is_file() against the actual repo filesystem.
doubts.fix: Added test_prompt_path_resolves_to_a_real_file, asserting prn._PROMPT_PATH.is_file() with no mocking.
